audience: administrators who manage company phones, tablets and computers with Hexnode

useCases.title: Find devices that have not reported
useCases.text: List the enrolled devices with their last-reported time and compliance. Open one device to see its hardware, owner and groups.

useCases.title: Check the policies and apps on a device
useCases.text: List the policies applied to one device and the apps installed on it. Read one policy to see its settings.

useCases.title: Read where a device was over time
useCases.text: List the locations a device reported over time. The portal returns them only with location tracking enabled.

useCases.title: Review users and device groups
useCases.text: List the users and open one to see its groups. List the device groups and open one to see its member devices.

useCases.title: Lock or restart devices after confirming
useCases.text: Lock devices, with an optional screen message, or restart them. Both need confirm set to true. Then read the action status.

useCases.title: Install an app on devices or groups
useCases.text: Find an app in the portal library, then install it on the devices or device groups you choose.
